This script runs as the NekoFlash app UID, not as a desktop shell or root. It can execute commands available on Android and can modify app-accessible files. The fastboot shim sends supported Fastboot commands through the currently connected USB device. Only run scripts from a source you trust. PATH stubs block bare su/run-as names only; absolute paths may bypass those stubs. Android shared storage may reject direct executable files, but sh script.sh can read a script from it.

Used permissions: • All files access — reads user-selected firmware, ZIP/APK and diagnostic files from /sdcard/Download/NekoFlash. • Notifications — shows a foreground operation notification. • Wake lock — keeps CPU awake only during flashing or sideload and is released after the operation. • Hide overlay windows — on Android 12+ blocks other apps from drawing over this app during sensitive actions. • Internet/network state — used only by the Mi Account / Mi Unlock flow to communicate with official Xiaomi HTTPS endpoints.
Not requested: • Draw over other apps / SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW. • Contacts, SMS, microphone, camera, phone, or location.

string-array.name: local_terminal_help
string-array.item: Host commands: help, echo, pwd, ls, cd, find, cat, grep, cp, mv, mkdir, rm and clear.
~ points to Download/NekoFlash. Quote paths that contain spaces.
local cd "ROM files" forces host routing, including inside an interactive ADB shell.
local getprop ro.build.version.release runs the host-phone diagnostic after system-shell opt-in.
adb shell getprop ro.build.version.release runs on the connected device.
fastboot getvar product runs through the app-owned Fastboot connection.
Scripts and mixed Fastboot shell commands require export NEKO_USE_DEVICE_BINARIES=1 and confirmation.
Scripts run as the app UID, not root. su and run-as are blocked by PATH stubs.
Disable system shell with export NEKO_USE_DEVICE_BINARIES=0.
